behaviour: Only the user who created an order may act on it; other users must receive 403.
Refunds are only allowed for orders with status 'delivered'; any other status must return 400.
The refund window is 14 days counted from delivered_at, not created_at; a request more than 14 days after delivered_at must return 400.
A refund request outside the 14-day window from delivered_at must return 400.
The refund amount must be greater than 0 and at most the order total; any other value must return 400.
A refunded order cannot be refunded again; a second refund request must return 400.
A successful refund sets the order status to 'refunded' and returns 200.
